description: RigSignal Steam Remote Play streaming_log parser v1. Parses line-local KPIs/anomalies and multiline SessionStats blocks.

set.value: steam-remote-play-v1: sha256(host_hostname|client_hostname|remote_ip:port|appid|codec|resolution|fps|session_start_10s); stateless ingest parses components, sessionizer stamps final id

date.if: ctx.steam != null && ctx.steam.log != null && ctx.steam.log.timestamp != null

script.source: def ensure(def root, String name) { if (root[name] == null) root[name] = new HashMap(); return root[name]; } void setPath(def root, String path, def value) { String[] parts = path.splitOnToken('.'); def cur = root; for (int i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) { if (cur[parts[i]] == null) cur[parts[i]] = new HashMap(); cur = cur[parts[i]]; } cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value; } def asDouble(String s) { try { return Double.parseDouble(s); } catch (Exception e) { return null; } } def asLong(String s) { try { return Long.parseLong(s); } catch (Exception e) { return null; } } def between(String s, String left, String right) { int a = s.indexOf(left); if (a < 0) return null; a += left.length(); int b = right == null ? s.length() : s.indexOf(right, a); if (b < 0) b = s.length(); return s.substring(a, b); } def after(String s, String token) { int a = s.indexOf(token); if (a < 0) return null; return s.substring(a + token.length()); } void kvSet(def root, String payload, String nl) { String[] lines = payload.splitOnToken(nl); for (String line : lines) { String trimmed = line.trim(); if (!trimmed.startsWith('"')) continue; int k2 = trimmed.indexOf('"', 1); if (k2 < 0) continue; String k = trimmed.substring(1, k2); int v1 = trimmed.indexOf('"', k2 + 1); if (v1 < 0) continue; int v2 = trimmed.indexOf('"', v1 + 1); if (v2 < 0) continue; String v = trimmed.substring(v1 + 1, v2); String base = 'stream.session.summary.'; if (k == 'appid') { setPath(root, 'stream.game.appid', asLong(v)); setPath(root, 'labels.appid', v); } else if (k == 'GameNameID') { setPath(root, 'stream.game.name', v); } else if (k == 'ResolutionX') { setPath(root, 'stream.video.width', asLong(v)); } else if (k == 'ResolutionY') { setPath(root, 'stream.video.height', asLong(v)); } else if (k == 'CaptureDescriptionID') { setPath(root, 'stream.capture.backend', v); if (v.contains('HEVC')) setPath(root, 'stream.video.codec', 'hevc'); else if (v.contains('H264') || v.contains('H.264')) setPath(root, 'stream.video.codec', 'h264'); } else if (k == 'DecoderDescriptionID') { setPath(root, 'stream.decode.backend', v); } else if (k == 'FramerateLimit') { setPath(root, 'stream.video.fps_limit', asDouble(v)); } else if (k == 'BandwidthLimit') { setPath(root, 'stream.network.bandwidth_limit_kbps', asLong(v)); } else if (k.startsWith('Slow') && k.endsWith('Percent')) { String stage = k.substring(4, k.length() - 7).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); setPath(root, 'stream.session.summary.slow_percent.' + stage, asDouble(v)); } else if (k.startsWith('Avg') || k.startsWith('StdDev')) { String out = k.substring(0,1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + k.substring(1); setPath(root, base + out, asDouble(v)); } else { setPath(root, base + k, v); } } } def metric(String p, String key) { String marker = key + ':'; int i = p.indexOf(marker); if (i < 0) return null; i += marker.length(); while (i < p.length() && p.charAt(i) == 32) i++; int j = i; while (j < p.length()) { int c = p.charAt(j); if ((c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 46 || c == 45) j++; else break; } if (j == i) return null; return asDouble(p.substring(i, j)); } String payload = ctx.steam != null && ctx.steam.log != null && ctx.steam.log.payload != null ? ctx.steam.log.payload : (ctx.message != null ? ctx.message : ''); if (payload.startsWith('CLIENT: ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.side', 'client_observed'); payload = payload.substring(8); } else { setPath(ctx, 'stream.side', 'host'); } setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'unparsed'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'unparsed'); if (payload.startsWith('Slow framerate:')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'slow_frame'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'slow_framerate'); setPath(ctx, 'event.kind', 'alert'); setPath(ctx, 'event.category', 'network'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.anomaly.flag', true); String[] stages = new String[] {'game','capture','convert','encode','network','decode','display'}; for (String st : stages) { def val = metric(payload.replace(',', ''), st); if (val != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.pipeline.' + st + '_ms', val); } String b = between(payload, '(', ')'); if (b != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.bottleneck.stage', b); } else if (payload.startsWith('Setting target framerate:')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'target_framerate'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'target_framerate'); def fps = between(payload, 'Setting target framerate: ', ' '); if (fps != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.target_fps', asDouble(fps)); String timing = between(payload, '[timing: ', ']'); if (timing != null) { String[] stages = new String[] {'game','capture','convert','encode','network','decode','display'}; String t = timing.replace(',', ''); for (String st : stages) { def val = metric(t, st); if (val != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.pipeline.' + st + '_ms', val); } String b = between(timing, '(', ')'); if (b != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.bottleneck.stage', b); } } else if (payload.startsWith('dynamicbitrate: data loss')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'data_loss'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'data_loss'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.loss.event', true); } else if (payload.startsWith('dynamicbitrate:')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'bitrate_sample'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'bitrate_sample'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.target_mbps', metric(payload, 'tgt')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.link_bandwidth_mbps', metric(payload, 'link')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.link_filtered_mbps', metric(payload, 'lp')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.measured_mbps', metric(payload, 'meas')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.instant_mbps', metric(payload, 'inst')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.ping_avg_ms', metric(payload, 'pavg')); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.ping_max_ms', metric(payload, 'pmax')); } else if (payload.contains('CGameStreamVideoStageVAAPI: Reinitializing ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'renegotiation'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'video_encoder_reinitialize'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.capture.backend', 'VAAPI'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.codec', 'hevc'); String r = after(payload, 'Reinitializing '); if (r != null) { int x = r.indexOf('x'); int sp = r.indexOf(' '); if (x > 0 && sp > x) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.width', asLong(r.substring(0, x))); setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.height', asLong(r.substring(x + 1, sp))); } } String kb = between(payload, ' at ', ' Kbit/s'); if (kb != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.server_bitrate_kbps', asLong(kb)); String fps = between(payload, ' and ', ' FPS'); if (fps != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.fps', asDouble(fps)); } else if (payload.startsWith('>>> Capture method set to ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'capture_backend'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'capture_method'); String v = after(payload, '>>> Capture method set to '); setPath(ctx, 'stream.capture.backend', v); if (v != null && v.contains('HEVC')) setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.codec', 'hevc'); } else if (payload.startsWith('>>> Client video decoder set to ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'decoder'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'client_decoder'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.decode.backend', after(payload, '>>> Client video decoder set to ')); } else if (payload.startsWith('>>> Capture resolution set to ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'capture_resolution'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'capture_resolution'); String r = after(payload, '>>> Capture resolution set to '); int x = r == null ? -1 : r.indexOf('x'); if (x > 0) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.width', asLong(r.substring(0, x))); setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.height', asLong(r.substring(x + 1))); } } else if (payload.startsWith('>>> Starting desktop stream')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'session_start'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'stream_start'); } else if (payload.startsWith('>>> Stopped desktop stream')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'session_stop'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'stream_stop'); } else if (payload.startsWith('Marking frame ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'frame_drop'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'frame_drop'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.anomaly.flag', true); String n = between(payload, 'Marking frame ', ' complete'); if (n != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.frame.id', asLong(n)); String st = after(payload, 'status '); if (st != null) setPath(ctx, 'stream.frame.status', st); } else if (payload.startsWith('Got video sequence ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'packet_loss'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'lost_data_notification'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.network.loss.event', true); } else if (payload.startsWith('Game Recording - game stopped [gameid=')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'game_stop'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'game_stop'); String id = between(payload, '[gameid=', ']'); if (id != null) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.game.appid', asLong(id)); setPath(ctx, 'labels.appid', id); } } else if (payload.startsWith('Game Recording - would start recording game ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'game_start'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'game_start'); String id = between(payload, 'game ', ','); if (id != null) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.game.appid', asLong(id)); setPath(ctx, 'labels.appid', id); } } else if (payload.startsWith('Adding process ') || payload.startsWith('Removing process ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'game_process'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', payload.startsWith('Adding') ? 'game_process_add' : 'game_process_remove'); String id = after(payload, 'gameID '); if (id != null) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.game.appid', asLong(id)); setPath(ctx, 'labels.appid', id); } } else if (payload.startsWith('GameScope focus changed to appID ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'focus'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'focus_app'); String id = after(payload, 'appID '); setPath(ctx, 'stream.game.appid', asLong(id)); setPath(ctx, 'labels.appid', id); } else if (payload.contains('Using VAAPI profile ')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'codec'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'codec_profile'); String prof = after(payload, 'Using VAAPI profile '); setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.codec_profile', prof); if (prof != null && prof.contains('HEVC')) setPath(ctx, 'stream.video.codec', 'hevc'); } else if (payload.contains('VAAPI DRM hardware decoding')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'decoder'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'client_decoder'); setPath(ctx, 'stream.decode.backend', 'VAAPI DRM hardware decoding'); } else if (payload.contains('"SessionStats"')) { setPath(ctx, 'stream.event.type', 'session_summary'); setPath(ctx, 'event.action', 'session_summary'); kvSet(ctx, payload, params.nl); } if (ctx.stream != null && ctx.stream.event != null && ctx.stream.event.type != 'unparsed') { setPath(ctx, 'tags', ctx.tags == null ? new ArrayList() : ctx.tags); ctx.tags.add('steam_stream_parsed'); }
